cfg.bad_enc: Encoding is {enc} — will be saved as UTF-8 without BOM
cfg.hint: Only values are changed — comments and file structure are preserved.
cfg.saved: Config saved as UTF-8 without BOM.
cfgvar.MaxPing: Ping (ms) at which a player is kicked from the server.
cfgvar.adminLogPlayerHitsOnly: 1 — log player hits only, 0 — all hits (animals/infected).
cfgvar.adminLogPlayerList: Periodic player list with positions (every 5 minutes).
cfgvar.allowFilePatching: Allow clients with -filePatching (required for debugging unpacked sources).
cfgvar.clientPort: Forces the port clients connect with.
cfgvar.defaultObjectViewDistance: Highest object render distance on the server.
cfgvar.defaultVisibility: Highest terrain render distance on the server.
cfgvar.description: Server description in the server browser (up to 255 characters).
cfgvar.disablePersonalLight: Disable personal light for all connected clients.
cfgvar.disableRespawnDialog: Hide the respawn point selection dialog.
cfgvar.enableDebugMonitor: Show the debug monitor to players.
cfgvar.forceSameBuild: Only allow clients with the same game build.
cfgvar.guaranteedUpdates: Communication protocol with the game server (use only 1).
cfgvar.hostname: Server name shown in the server browser.
cfgvar.instanceId: Instance identifier (storage_<id> folder inside the mission).
cfgvar.logAverageFps: Log average server FPS every N seconds (needs -doLogs).
cfgvar.logFile: Server console log file in the profile folder.
cfgvar.logMemory: Log memory usage every N seconds (needs -doLogs).
cfgvar.logPlayers: Log connected player count every N seconds (needs -doLogs).
cfgvar.loginQueueConcurrentPlayers: How many players are processed concurrently during login.
cfgvar.loginQueueMaxPlayers: Maximum number of players waiting in the login queue.
cfgvar.multithreadedReplication: Multithreaded replication (thread count comes from dayzsettings.xml).
cfgvar.networkObjectBatchBandwidthLimit: The limit itself: fraction [0,1] or number [1,∞) — depends on the setting above.
cfgvar.networkObjectBatchCompute: Objects checked for create/delete per server frame.
cfgvar.networkObjectBatchEnforceBandwidt: Limit object creation based on bandwidth usage.
cfgvar.networkObjectBatchLogSlow: Threshold (sec): logs a network "bubble" if processing takes longer.
cfgvar.networkObjectBatchSendCreate: Maximum objects sent for creation per frame.
cfgvar.networkObjectBatchSendDelete: Maximum objects sent for deletion per frame.
cfgvar.networkObjectBatchUseDynamicMaxim: Bandwidth limit as a fraction of the current maximum, not a hard number.
cfgvar.networkObjectBatchUseEstimatedBan: 0 — actual data sent last frame, 1 — rough estimate.
cfgvar.networkRangeClose: Network bubble (m): close objects with items inside (backpacks). Default 20.
cfgvar.networkRangeNear: Network bubble (m): near inventory items. Default 150.
cfgvar.password: Password to join the server (empty — no password).
cfgvar.pingCritical: Ping (ms) at which the red ping warning is shown.
cfgvar.pingWarning: Ping (ms) at which the yellow ping warning is shown.
cfgvar.respawnTime: Delay (seconds) before a new character can be created after death.
cfgvar.serverFpsWarning: Server FPS below which the warning is shown (minimum 11).
cfgvar.simulatedPlayersBatch: Limit of players simulated per server frame.
cfgvar.timeStampFormat: Timestamp format in the RPT: Full or Short.
cfgvar.verifySignatures: PBO signature verification: 2 — enabled (.bikey files required in keys), 0 — disabled (for development).
check.battleye: Diag mode usually requires battleye=0 — check the parameters if the server fails to start.
check.config_enc: Config encoding is not UTF-8 without BOM — it will be fixed automatically.
check.mikero: Mods {mods} need repacking, but pboProject was not found: {p}
check.port: UDP port {port} is in use — a server may already be running (old processes will be terminated).
check.profiles_empty: Profile folder is not set — the server will write logs to its default folder.
check.profiles_missing: Profile folder does not exist and will be created: {p}
collection.all_present: All collection mods are already in the registry.
collection.bad_url: Could not recognize the collection link.
collection.missing_msg: Missing mods: {n} of {total}. Subscribe to them in Steam, refresh the mod list and reconnect the collection — or connect what's already there.
collection.title: Steam collection
collection.url_prompt: Steam Workshop collection link (or its id):
connect.hint: The checkbox connects the mod (at the end of the load order). «Server» — mod goes into -serverMod (defaults from the mod's settings on the «Mods» tab, can be overridden here). The ↑↓ arrows change the order. Click a column header to sort by it.
connect.title: Connect mods — {n}
connect.type_tip: Client/Server is set by the «Server» flag on the «Mods» tab.
dl.no_path: Path {p} not found in the archive
dl.title: Downloading mission: {n}
flags.hint: Flags are mod labels with a custom name and color. The color paints the mod's name in the lists. Assigned via right-click on a mod on the «Mods» tab → «Flags».
flags.title: Mod flags
launch.server_died: Server exited during startup (code {code}). Check the RPT log.
launch.server_ready: Server ready, port {port} bound after {sec} s.
launch.server_slow: Server did not bind the port within {sec} s — starting the client anyway.
log.clear_tip: Clears the window; log files are not touched.
log.delete_tip: Deletes all log files in the folder. The window is not cleared.
main.about:
A utility for launching a DayZ Standalone test environment and debugging mods.

GPLv3 license — free forever.
https://github.com/KRdayzmodding/KR_ServerManager

by [Kramtsov Arms]
main.cfg_fixed: Config encoding fixed to UTF-8 without BOM.
main.del_files: Also delete the preset files: config, profile and mission (including storage)
main.nothing: Select what to launch: server and/or client.
mission.map_missing: Map mod not found — the mission won't start without it.
mission.recreate_tip: Recreate the preset mission from the template
mission.recreate_warn:
"{n}" will be recreated from the actual.<map> template.
Your edits to mission files will be lost.
mission.st_copy: {n} — will be created from template {t} (no download)
mission.st_dl_tpl: Template {t} will be downloaded from github.com/{repo}; mission {n} is its local copy
mission.upd_tip: Update the actual.<map> template from GitHub
mods.add_dir_pick: Folder with mods or a single @mod folder
mods.add_dir_tip: A folder containing @mods, or a single @mod folder.
mods.add_none: No @mods in the folder — nothing to add.
mods.add_ok_dir: Folder added. Valid mods: {v}, with problems: {p}
mods.deps_edit_hint: Check the mods that «{m}» requires. When «{m}» is added to a preset, the missing ones will be offered automatically.
mods.deps_hint: "{m}" depends on the following Steam Workshop mods:
mods.deps_note: Mods that aren't subscribed need to be subscribed in Steam first — the link opens the mod's page. After subscribing and downloading, click "Refresh" on the Mods tab to connect them.
mods.flags_btn_tip: Custom mod labels (name + color) — assigned via right-click on a mod.
mods.hidden_btn_tip: Mods removed from the list via the "Remove from list" context menu item.
mods.hidden_hint: Check the mods you want to bring back into the list.
mods.hint: The checkbox enables the mod (appended to the load order). "Server-side" — the mod goes to -serverMod. Use ↑↓ to change the order. Double-click "Sources" to link a local mod's sources for packing. In list view, click a column header to sort by it.
mods.outdated_tip: A newer version of this mod is available on Steam Workshop.
mods.rebuild_tip: Rebuild PBOs from all linked sources.
mods.remove_dir: Remove this folder from local mods list
mods.server_tip: Server-side mod: attached to the server only via -serverMod.
mods.sets_hint: You can pick several sets at once — their mods will be merged.
mods.sources_add_tip: You can pick several folders at once (Ctrl/Shift+click).
mods.sources_hint: One source folder = one PBO in addons. The packer compares source file dates with the PBO date.
mods.val_ascii: {n}: non-latin characters are not allowed in the folder name
mods.view_tip: Switch between a tree grouped by source and a flat sortable list (click a column header to sort).
param.BEpath: Custom path to the BattlEye files.
param.adminLog: Writes a log of admin actions and hits (ADM file).
param.battleye: Enable/disable BattlEye. For Diag and local development set 0 (disabled).
param.cpuCount: Number of CPU cores the server may use.
param.doLogs: Enables server logs (RPT, script.log) in the profile folder.
param.filePatching: Allows loading unpacked files (sources) over PBOs. Required for debugging without packing. Diag builds usually require 1.
param.freezeCheck: Watches for server freezes and writes a dump on freeze.
param.limitFPS: Server loop FPS limit, max 200 (reduces CPU load).
param.name: Client character name.
param.netLog: Enables network traffic logging. Rarely needed, slows the server down.
param.newErrorsAreWarnings: New script errors are treated as warnings — the game does not crash on them (Diag only).
param.noPause: Do not pause the game when the window is minimized/unfocused.
param.password: Server password, if set in serverDZ.cfg (password).
param.scrDef: Script preprocessor definitions, e.g. BITWISEDEBUG (Diag only).
param.storage: Custom root folder for the storage (persistence files).
param.window: Start the client in windowed mode.
pbo.appid_tip: Leave empty unless this is paid DLC content.
pbo.b_tip: Checks mission.sqm and config.cpp for errors via a trial binarisation.
pbo.c_tip: “All bets are off” — rebuilds absolutely everything, including what hasn't changed.
pbo.clean_meta_tip: *.meta is Workbench clutter that throws off comparing source/pbo dates.
pbo.d_tip: png files successfully converted to paa are deleted from the temp folder.
pbo.dollar_tip: A rare option — don't touch it unless you know why you need it.
pbo.extra_hint: Recognised as-is from previous settings — appended unchanged at the end.
pbo.g_tip: Subscribers of the corresponding Mikero service only.
pbo.h_tip: DayZ sometimes uses png directly — disables the attempt to convert it to paa.
pbo.hint: pboProject command-line flags. “Not set” — use whatever is left configured in pboProject itself (unpredictable between runs); set it explicitly if the exact behaviour matters.
pbo.k_file_tip: Needed if PBO signing is enabled above.
pbo.k_tip: Creates a .bisign next to the pbo and puts the public key in keys/. If a private key is set below, signing is enabled automatically regardless of this toggle.
pbo.n_tip: A lot of extra output — useful when tracking down an error, but noticeably slows down packing.
pbo.o_tip: Protects sources from being viewed in a hex editor, but an obfuscated pbo can no longer be extracted.
pbo.p_tip: Required for automated builds — without it pboProject may open its GUI and wait for user input, hanging the build.
pbo.q: Delete wav/wss after converting to ogg
pbo.s_tip: Otherwise pboProject keeps building the remaining pbos even if one of them failed.
pbo.title: PboProject settings
pbo.w_tip: The build stops on any warning, not just an error.
pbo.x_excl_tip: Comma-separated files/masks that won't go into the pbo at all.
pbo.z_excl_tip: Comma-separated files/masks that shouldn't be compressed (e.g. *.paa,*.ogg).
pbo.z_tip: The compression-exclusion list is a separate field below.
preflight.blocked: Critical problems found — launch is not possible:
preflight.ignore: Ignore these warnings until the program is restarted
preflight.title: Pre-launch check
preflight.warnings: There are warnings. You can continue.
preset.bad_name_full: Invalid name. Only latin letters, digits, "-" and "_" are allowed — no Cyrillic or spaces. For example: my_test_server
preset.clear_db_confirm:
Delete storage_* in mission "{m}"?
Loot, characters and bases will be reset.
preset.clear_db_tip: Deletes storage_* folders in the preset mission — resets persistence (loot, characters, bases).
preset.clear_prof_tip: Completely clears the server profile folder (logs, mod settings).
preset.lazy_auto:
Config and profile will be created automatically:
{d}\{f}.cfg  and  {d}\{p}\{f}
preset.lazy_dedicated_missing: DayZServer_x64.exe not found — set the server folder in Settings.
preset.lazy_diag_desc: The game runs in diagnostic mode, filepatching works.
preset.lazy_diag_missing: DayZDiag_x64.exe not found — set the game folder in Settings.
preset.lazy_done:
The preset will be created with sensible defaults.
Attach mods on the "Mods" tab, tune parameters in the "Advanced" editor.
preset.mode_diag: Diag: DayZDiag_x64 as both server and client (debugging, filepatching)
preset.name: Name
preset.name_reserved: The name "{n}" is reserved for map templates.
preset.name_taken: A preset "{n}" for this map already exists.
preset.time_login_tip: TimeLogin and TimeLogout in the mission's db\globals.xml — the wait timers when joining and leaving. Set as one value; 0 is handy for debugging.
settings.admins_tip: Admin SteamID64s — one per line. Used by admin mods.
settings.downloads_tip: Shared storage for downloaded map mods; they are attached to every root via junction links.
settings.engine_full_missing: Full, with checks (pboProject) — unavailable, pboProject not found
settings.engine_tip: pbo_packer is much faster, but doesn't check for errors or sign pbos — local debugging only.
settings.pbo_settings_missing: pboProject was not found at the configured Mikero Tools path — fix the path to open these settings.
settings.pbo_settings_tip: pboProject command-line flags: signing, compression, file processing, etc. — with an explanation for each.
settings.prefix_tip: Inserted into the hostname of created servers.
settings.steam_key_hint: Used to resolve Steam mod dependencies via the official API. How to get it: press "Get one", sign in to Steam, enter anything into "Domain Name" (e.g. localhost), accept the terms and paste the key here. Without a key, dependencies are read from the workshop page — works, but less reliable.
wizard.admin_hint: Used by admin mods to grant permissions. You can find your own SteamID64 on steamid.io or in your Steam profile properties.
wizard.bat_partial: Not everything was recognized — complete the preset in the editor after import.
wizard.done_text:
Setup is complete. Everything can be changed later in "Settings".

Next: create or pick a preset, attach mods on the "Mods" tab
and press "Launch".
wizard.import_sub: The app parses launch lines in .bat files and tries to create presets from them. It does not work with every .bat — review what was recognized and uncheck what you don't need.
wizard.no_workshop: Workshop not found (can be set later in Settings)
wizard.paths_help: It's fine if something isn't found or installed — leave the field empty and fill it in later in Settings once it's ready. A red border means the path is set but the folder isn't there right now (e.g. the game is installed but this specific folder was removed, or the registry has a leftover trace of an old install). DayZ, the Experimental version and the dedicated server are installed and updated through Steam (your game library and the "Tools" tab for DayZ Tools); Mikero Tools (DePboTools) is a separate free utility from the developer's site — search for it by name.
wizard.paths_sub: Paths were detected from the Steam registry. Review and adjust if needed.
wizard.prefix_hint: Will be inserted into the hostname of created servers — no need to type it in every time. Can be changed later in Settings.
wizard.steam_sub: Both fields are optional and easy to fill in later in Settings — but it's simplest not to forget them now.
wizard.title: KR Server Manager — first-time setup
